notes.title: Angeldust v3.35 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.35:

[h1]More Than a Feeling[/h1]
Angeldust v3.35 brings emoji. All of them. Everywhere! You can directly type emoji characters, paste them from your clipboard or use the builtin shortcode picker:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/de9ca3dbed79d92d3a6e5124839b0f155a1c2653.jpg[/img]

After typing a colon and two or more characters, use the down and up arrow, or comma (,) and period (.) to select which emoji to enter. Confirm with the Return/Enter key or a colon (:).

The Angeldust emoji are identical on all platforms. They're based on [url=https://openmoji.org]OpenMoji[/url], licensed under Creative Commons (CC) BY-SA 4.0. SVG source files are available in Angeldust Creator Kit, also including a handy list of all available emoji shortcodes:

https://angeldu.st/en/forums/topics/9179/AngeldustCreatorKit

[h1]Signal and Sign[/h1]
Angeldust v3.35 lets you put all our 1,500 emoji to good use in a new "killer" feature: a placeable text sign. Click to place, pick one of the dozen cool sign styles and enter text.

Use text-based hints to set up colors, font sizes, line breaks and character styles like slanting and monospacing:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/c3982bfaa3a1a1dcafe03a8b8906f3c019951470.jpg[/img]

The text sign user interface lets you change the position, text alignment and style on the fly:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/8d1be7651988b6031b40f76f75403a2e2176e61e.gif[/img]

While typing and previewing your text sign, as you approach the size limits, the game lets you know that text signs can be about "yea big":

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/576dd67138ef9bd974f037258a93b143b5a93ba0.jpg[/img]

The in-game block picker lets you block pick any text sign's style, anchoring, text alignment and it will even automatically translate contents for you so you know what any sign says:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/54f15e4229ff5da49ffa2a6cbfb866cf45f8e6f3.jpg[/img]

On PlayAngeldust.com you can also edit text sign contents post-placement. Just sign in with your player name and password and go to the 'Placed text' page. This lets you find and edit the contents of your text signs, holo scrolls and NPC markers.

[h1]But wait! There's more![/h1]
ngl no cap fr fr the text sign was supposed to be this update's main feature, but during development it got completely overshadowed by its twin: the tailored panel. The tailored panel lets you place a custom-sized panel with any design you can dream up, with a special, interactive user interface:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/7773df4b1f6f1b9db0bd2fd36eca47a70da6f24f.jpg[/img]

Scale your panel all the way from 1/4 x 1/4 up to 4 x 4. The range is like from a jeep to a peej (inverted jeep, get it!). You can anchor panels anywhere on a block face:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/86a8ffa3851142cc42c0b90724d564f698a1beed.jpg[/img]

And you can then also make them expand in any direction you like, even outside of the block you placed them on. And every texture gets lovingly cropped, stretched, scaled, rotated on the fly. Just look at this magnificent, horizontal bamboo strip:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/4619cf2fc51b7181d23a3529e17142e845584eba.jpg[/img]

There are over 190,000,000 (that's 190 million) different panels that you can create. Combined with the text sign this adds an admittedly ridiculous amount of customization to Angeldust. And to make things even easier, the block picker also copies tailored panel properties so you can quickly copy existing designs.

[h1]Hole in my Life[/h1]
The tailored panel is amazingly cool. But like most 2D in-world Angeldust things, it doesn't have solidity to it. To plug this hole, Angeldust v3.35 brings the "barrier". An invisible block that does nothing. Ha ha. Got ya! It's super handy to fill up the space of tailored panels, and the barrier will cast shadows.

More importantly, the barrier lets you place decorations on top of tailored panels, because it slightly offsets stuff that's placed on it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/c09e7e6dcf0267c8ccf510bae255717f307a4d3d.jpg[/img]

In the example above the giant crate is a tailored panel. The "pet snack" drawing is placed on top because it's on a barrier block. Layering decorations is going to be the new pastime in Angeldust!

[h1]The Two-Time World Champion[/h1]
Angeldust v3.35 brings a shameful amount of improvements to the world map. First, just look at this map of Ruan4K's Valessi:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/83f0cb18714309a01a46e88bef61ac9dc6033bfd.jpg[/img]

Beautiful, right? That's because the world map now has material color mixing, bidirectional shadows, long shadows, block decorations and larger objects. Next look at this map from Rob12's Equatoria:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/f5da09c3c632d3d79713bcacd250e80960fdc463.jpg[/img]

Beautiful, right? That's because the world map now has transparency, correct colors for palm trees, better color rendering of functional blocks and it shows players and NPC names by default.

Finally, the world map is more responsive during rendering and also shows creature markers, a marker for your "mount" and much more:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/3e7364e16daf43315c5e7735fb2d1a4999b20aa4.jpg[/img]

[h1]But wait again! There's still more![/h1]
All these world map improvements perform double duty in a new "killer" feature: a minimap! Something that I considered entirely impossible, but that is here thanks to @obi- and @Hummm.

The (resizable and hideable) minimap is rendered top-right while playing and shows everything the world map does: a beautiful view of the world and real-time markers for many things:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/841a5a4a964f4b0acfe9711d3816e9334712606f.jpg[/img]

There are markers for your "mount", for the "inland" direction, for "North". And when you start moving, the minimap zooms out. Stop moving and it zooms in. Get into a fight and it also zooms in so you can see your surroundings. Press the N-key (customizable) to change minimap sizes, or select one in the Options menu. It's great.

[h1]The Gigashadow[/h1]
Best kept secret: all previous Angeldust versions rendered incorrect shadows for heroes riding on creatures. This is fixed now. Once you knew it was impossible to unsee. I spared you this frustration.

[h1]Good things come in threes[/h1]
Somewhere in the past months I added "creature nests" to Angeldust. Surprise encounters where you have to fight a ton of creature. It's a lot of fun!

[h1]Know your place[/h1]
While placing decorations you will now see a small gizmo in the block placement box. This indicates to which face your decoration will stick. Especially helpful when placing text signs and tailored panels:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/03069e407fc59c65e41535e4822ab89447c0def6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sometimes… you won't forget things anymore[/h1]
Uhm. Angeldust used to just delete any text you entered in a text field. No longer. If you click or tap a text input box, the text is now retained and you can edit the text instead of having to retype it. Ooh boy, very nice!

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[*] fixed "overridden" items like the saddle affecting user interface state
[*] improved font outline smoothness
[*] improved responsiveness of user interface in most common game scenarios
[*] changed screen background color when in hotbar assignment or item blueprint assignment mode
[*] improved appearance of transparent user interface elements
[*] improved rendering performance at Normal energy saving
[*] fix photon mimics not initializing correctly when visiting a new area
[*] fix scroll bars making a hover sound when they're invisible
[*] added text hint blueprint to chat log
[*] moved item blueprint to hotbar to fix it overlapping scroll controls
[*] moved corner and edge buttons exactly to corners and edges to improve usability
[*] improved touchscreen input handling
[*] improved soft keyboard handling on Android
[*] optimize appearance of game world when in free flight cinematic mode
[*] fixed Z-fighting of in-hand transparent chair block bottom face (thanks @Loki The Witful)

[h1]Community note[/h1]
Angeldust has a great community that I'm insanely happy to be allowed to partake in. This update has taken almost half a year to perfect and it's my love letter to everyone involved with Angeldust. Whether you're a builder, a fighter or a lover, there's something new and cool here to enjoy.

I couldn't have done this without the support of all of you, the players. Know that you are loved and appreciated. Contributors, (GM)s, Wonder Builders, Donators, Lottery Winners, Pioneers and all others—you're all champions!

notes.title: Angeldust v3.33
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.33:

[h1]Turbocharged performance[/h1]
Angeldust v3.33 increases the game world drawing speed three- to fourfold! Expect much better interactivity while building in complex areas, and while loading in existing builds. It's a very noticeable performance improvement without any downsides.

[h1]Seeing double[/h1]
A biggie: previous Angeldust versions used to render on-screen 2D sprites twice. Why? I don't know. In Angeldust v3.33 everything is rendered just once, like it should. This improves performance and removes a lot of weird artifacts around sprite edges. The only downside is that you can no longer seemingly ride two horses at once. But one horse should be enough for anyone!

[h1]Touch tips[/h1]
Angeldust v3.33 introduces a few user interface improvements for new players that play on a touchscreen. The 'menu grid' icon will now glow, bounce and spark until it's pressed. Hopefully this helps new players discover the inventory screen and the in-game shop. Speaking of which, the 'Shop' button now has a giant bouncing coin and arrow above it as long as nothing been bought. Let's go shopping!

[h1]Map this![/h1]
In a world-first, our well-known community member [b]obi-[/b], has contributed some code for Angeldust v3.33. The first feature they worked on is that mimics and photon mimics now appear on the world map. Builders, rejoice!

[h1]Block picker assignment[/h1]
Another cool, new [b]obi-[/b] feature is that you can now assign blocks to your hotbar slots using the block picker. Open the inventory grid, and double click, double tap or double 'number key' on the keyboard to go back in-game. Then use the golden block picker item to assign directly to the hotbar slot. Builders, rejoice once more!

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Unlockable cell/object 'yellow glow' hints now fade out when not in-game
[*] User interface text bounces and color pulses now share a global timer
[*] Decals (stickers) on the bottom of blocks now follow the same logic as decals on top of blocks
[/list]

notes.title: Angeldust v3.32
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.32:

[h1]One small step![/h1]
Angeldust v3.32 only exists to fix a movement bug that snuck into the previous update. You can now once again take small steps instead of always taking a double-sized step. Wow, amazing!

(Thanks to [i]Moniq[/i] for reporting this; this update is for you!)

[h1]Let's go shopping![/h1]
Most blocks and objects now only cost 100 coins! And I redesigned the in-game item shop—behold this amazingly annotated image:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/348833b73b9830e1ee5c3e8bc51ea9ed5c57b44f.jpg[/img]

Here's the same content, but in [i]even more text[/i]:
[list]
[*] Cheap blocks and objects (100 coins!) are now condensed into a grid for a better overview and to make the scroll bar actually useful.
[*] Buying a cheap block or object no longer triggers a fullscreen banner popup, so you can just buy everything you need in an instant.
[*] Purchases now show up under the top right coin counter, and the coin counter will now finally settle and 'ka-ching' in the shop and inventory screens.
[*] Drawings and paintings have been merged into one category, and their titles are now much shorter and to the point.
[*] Most irrelevant player details like (full) health and sprinting status are now hidden in the shop.
[*] The 'filter by color' icon now actually shows colors… wow!
[/list]

[h1]Gonna give 'm reason to be bouncing![/h1]
In Angeldust v3.32 some text and icons will bounce up and down to draw attention. Don't worry—it's done with a lot of taste and tact. In fact, it makes the game feel much more alive and fun!

In more text-related news: some input fields now have semitransparent placeholder text.

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Player details no longer linger when going back in-game
[*] Photon mimic light source changes won't stall game world rendering anymore (hi [i]Loki The Witful[/i]!)
[*] Slightly optimized rendering performance
[*] Improved aesthetics of the inventory screen when assigning an item to a hotbar slot
[*] The yellow 'unlockable materials' hint overlay now updates to match terrain changes
[*] The 'claimable land' item is now simply called 'Claim land'
[*] Website 'blocks' page item order now matches the in-game shop
[*] Fixed some problems with players having insane (16MM+) coin amounts (hi [i]Hummm[/i]!)
[*] The 'color your heroes' in-game tip now shows the player's hero with rotating colors
[*] Removed telecharger icon spam when signing-in with many pending friend requests
[/list]

notes.title: Angeldust v3.31
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.31:

[h1]Placeable block decorations![/h1]
Angeldust v3.31 brings placeable block decorations like plants, flowers, rocks and mushrooms. You can stick these to the side of any block or object to make nicer vegetation, flower fields, tree roots and much more. Here's a mysterious, overgrown temple built by [i]Loki The Witful[/i] showcasing the feature:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/c1963506709df3e08347b50cfa05b72a61fa5b5d.jpg[/img]

Block decorations also widen the top or bottom of column blocks. And there is a special 'empty decoration' that you can use to place above and hide naturally occurring grass, plants and rocks. This finally allows you to create kempt gardens.

[h1]Panda loves the bush and leaves[/h1]
The 'dense bush' no longer looks square at its bottom. And both the dense bush and leaves objects will now move along with the natural, big foliage in the game world so that they blend in much better. Paxanima trees have never looked better than this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/7346a7e1fba6c3a0fa9b95a5f2178cbcd03d58ab.jpg[/img]

[h1]Double tap[/h1]
Angeldust used to 'eat' short movement inputs on keyboard and game controllers if you were already moving. That's fixed now—any additional movement taps while already moving will now be processed. Good news for all you W+M1'ers.

[h1]Pop-art![/h1]
Enjoy five new paintings by [i]ritpop[/i]! Here's four of them in both the Hand-painted and Cartoon visual styles:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/b64a92d619a23b8112901c4729647235fd1475a1.jpg[/img]

Besides five paintings there's also a new 'rope net' sticker.

[h1]Web of wonder[/h1]
Since quite some time you can claim infinitely many lands in Angeldust on a single account. The Angeldust website at PlayAngeldust.com now has a 'Land' section where you can manage the order and visibility of all your land claims.

And, in more website news, there is now an [url=https://angeldu.st/static/webgl]online playable WebGL version of the game[/url]. Just click and play, anywhere!

[h1]Xin chào![/h1]
Angeldust v3.31 adds Vietnamese language support. It is far from perfect at the moment, but it's a starting point to get players from Vietnam up to speed with the game. If you speak English and Vietnamese, please get in touch to help improve the translation:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/c2a13ff39ffc321427f1dbbfe27579bd741818a9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Fast as lightning[/h1]
If you're playing on a slower device you will notice and appreciate Angeldust v3.31's faster building feedback when placing blocks. Using a bit of magic this reduces the new block time-to-draw from multiple milliseconds to 'instant'.

[h1]Lights, camera, … snow![/h1]
You can now set the cinematic time independently of precipitation. Make it snow at night! Have clear skies in the morning! This offers maximal flexibility to content creators for capturing the perfect picture or video:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/c33cd50d9379153ed1874580079c1d7087fbc823.jpg[/img]

Or combine this with the 'in-game' cinematic mode to always play in the rain or snow. It's comfy!

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Align block face texture highlights to daytime sun position
[*] Fix decal (sticker) geometry on rotating panels (doors)
[*] Reduce widened panel (door) texture warping
[*] User interface bug fixes
[*] Fix Photon mimic-related crashes (thanks to [i]Loki The Witful[/i])
[*] Improve random number generation (RNG) spread
[*] Make website side bar clickable on newer Safari versions
[*] Fix 'Hero battle!' area jailbreaks (thanks to [i]SodaMeow[/i])
[*] Make Assistana proactively give tips to new players
[/list]

notes.title: Angeldust is Free on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]New Deal[/h1]
Angeldust is now fully Free on Steam. No gotchas. Come join our fantastic community and see what we've built up over the years!

[b]NOTE: Our servers might be temporarily overloaded due to new player interest. If you can not connect or see 'Update Available' when connecting, please try again later; we're working on it![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/04930ae46ddfe0876b180d9b0a5212d2b07d65fc.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Stuff[/h1]
Angeldust has grown a lot. On top of our 'casual action MMO' core of exploration, discovery, fighting and building, we've added:
[list]
[*] 2D and 3D visual styles
[*] dungeons with speedrunning and random legendary loot drops
[*] NPCs with scripting and interactive dialogs
[*] game world interaction and automation; 'photon' system
[*] new block types, stickers, paintings, drawings and 'undo' and 'redo'
[*] Russian, Indonesian and Thai languages
[*] daily quests with unique rewards
[/list]
If you've been holding out on trying the game, now's the best time to hop in! Our warm and friendly community will get you up to speed in no-time and with our automated in-game text translation you can talk to anybody, anywhere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/80da8e91f266b8fad8b30f62c7411ac08c998de7.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Mods[/h1]
The first kind of 'mod' we have is game modding! Download Angeldust Creator Kit to start your journey creating content and customizing the game to your liking:
https://angeldu.st/en/forums/topics/9179/Angeldust+Creator+Kit


The second 'mods' we have are our lovely (GM) game moderators that will help you get up to speed in the game quickly. You can interactively chat with them, or send them private messages for later. There's also a huge forum with tips, memes and other cool stuff on the game's website:
http://PlayAngeldust.com


Our website is your best bet for getting the most out of Angeldust. It'll let you change your hero colors, unlock your rewards, manage your land claims and even interactively edit the text of holo scrolls that you placed in the game world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/527607142a67e3f6be2c5025f2ca9535cb28d00b.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Wonders[/h1]
Even now, after more than ten years of development, both lead developer Firefly and the entire Angeldust community are still pushing Angeldust forwards. New technological advances are coming, and players have been building more wonderful builds than ever before.

Using the built-in '[b]/tw N[/b]' console command you can easily visit all 42 current game world wonders. They're truly magical and beautiful and we're looking forward to expanding this list with your creations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/70ecb63729c16d8c5c7f99bb36c40128e3a577f8.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Start[/h1]
Starting up in a giant, new world is pretty intimidating, so let us be your guide! Come visit the weekly livestreams on YouTube where we hunt together, give away pet snacks and enjoy fan-made memes and videos:
https://www.youtube.com/AngeldustLive


Join our official community Discord server:
https://discord.gg/m8FekP3


And make sure to visit and sign in to the game's website to unlock all the advanced functionality that is available:
http://PlayAngeldust.com


You're free to join our fantastic and warm community anytime, you'll enjoy it! Have a great day.

notes.title: DUNGEONS EVERYWHERE!
notes.content:
[i]Darkness falls across the land. You hear whispering echoes of something—or someone—looking for help. An airy voice beckons you closer. The gold also helps.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/e145c5cb212f861d77dec67d0471a9bd12e03920.jpg[/img]

[i]You can't help but follow. Find out what is going on. With your usual Angeldust bravery you battle the creatures surrounding you. But not this one. They are part of 'you'. Plural. Wading through cold fog.

Another whisper disturbs the cold air. "Hoooome." Did you hear that right?! A mysterious thunderstorm acts as an exclamation point to all the chaos that led up to it. Another path reveals itself. You ascend the stairs… new challenges await![/i]

[h1]Dungeons. Mysteries. Puzzles.[/h1]
[b]Yes![/b] Angeldust v3.24 brings you radical new stealth and puzzle gameplay, rare and legendary loot, new skill customization options and special rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/04930ae46ddfe0876b180d9b0a5212d2b07d65fc.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Dungeons[/h2]
Dungeons can be found randomly throughout almost the entire Angeldust game world—except for very close to the village. You will definitely notice when you get nearby, see the opening story for hints on how to piece this first puzzle together.

[h2]The Gameplay[/h2]
Contrary to the usual Angeldust [i]spiel[/i] of constructing buildings and battling your way through creatures you'll need more tact and cunning to overcome the new challenges you'll find inside dungeons. Look for clues, try different approaches and when push comes to shove, a bit of brute force might help too.

[h2]The Loot[/h2]
Over at PlayAngeldust.com you can closely follow everyone's dungeoneering progress, including yours. Dungeon loot is handed out every 50 dungeon completions. Each hero can obtain a powerful, new item, but the order in which you unlock them is randomized.

Once you've completed 50 dungeons, the first item always unlocks, but you'll need to try each of the four heroes to see what you get. After 100 dungeons you get another item, but again for a random hero. This shakes up Angeldust's 'everything is available' model and it's already a hit with long-time players.

[h2]The Skills[/h2]
Each dungeon allows you to customize your hero's skills a bit more. You're always getting better, but you decide how. This section is intentionally kept vague so you can explore the options yourself.

[h2]The Rewards[/h2]
Every dungeon completion grants you a spendable dungeon point. The PlayAngeldust.com Rewards page now has over a dozen new creature rewards that you can unlock using dungeon points. Get a cool new horse or bear. Or go for the literal big league and unlock the amazing new 'Lector' mammoth to ride on.

[h2]The Lowdown[/h2]
Dungeons offer a great new way to enjoy Angeldust. You can do them by yourself, enjoying the puzzles at your own leisurely pace. Dungeons are not time-limited and can be found multiple times per day. This makes them a great target for grinding and ultimately unlocking all awesome, rare rewards.

[h1]Gotta Go Fast (optionally)![/h1]
Right. Once you are accustomed to dungeons there's another level of challenge that you can go for. [i]Speedrunning[/i]! That's right! Angeldust now has built-in speedrunning for dungeons.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/de5376bdbe772b9195d657ff3f46f743079ff9e4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/34e0b35bb2ab906c1d00ad12e2393ffac4485cc0.png[/img][/url]

There's a brand new Speedrun player leaderboard at PlayAngeldust.com. Totally optional, but if you like the challenge you can try your hand at sequence breaking, cheating and glitching your way through dungeons. Dungeons are (presumed to be) watertight without total sequence breakage, but individual components can be abused for speed. It's all allowed. [i]ANY% FTW.[/i]

As with any speedrun, you'll want to plan and route, optimize movement, use individual hero skills to your advantage and most of all, pray for good RNG. It's a phenomenally fun and addictive way to experience Angeldust like never before!

What is seemingly a small change makes a major impact on the game. Photon balls no longer use a wonky physics model for bouncing off of heroes. They are now directly controllable by looking in the direction you want them to go. This has much finer-grained precision and makes them fun. Finally!

notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.20:

[h1]"Icon" do this all day![/h1]
Angeldust v3.20 has a new vibrant, crisp and cheery icon. It's an homage to both our colorful community of heroes as well as the old icon. Enjoy this new piece of artwork on your desktop, quick launch bar and macOS Dock.

[h1]Where "art" thou?[/h1]
Our amazing community made ten new in-game drawings and paintings, ranging from a poster promoting pet snacks, via colorful dustbunny-inspired drawings to detailed landscape paintings. Thanks to these artists contributing their work:
[list]
[*] Angelio
[*] fatih+
[*] Kanmaike
[*] Loki The Witful
[*] obi-
[*] Rob12
[*] Ruan4K
[*] Snowhiteprincess
[*] SodaMeow
[/list]
[h1]Home is where the art is[/h1]
Besides new drawings and painting you'll now have access to about a dozen more new decorations like window curtains, shutters and metal slabs. These so-called 'mimic-sticky' decorations stick to mimic blocks so you can make three-layered windows and other cool designs that were previously impossible.

Another trick is sticking these decorations on a bare mimic block. This will hide the mimic block to allow for free-standing designs. You can even makes these climbable using the thin mimic block.

[h1]Panda eats shoots and leaves[/h1]
Angeldust v3.20 brings an improved 'leaves' object for the builder hero that you can use to design foliage. Available in ten contemporary colors you'll be creating beautiful trees and vegetation in no-time. Things will look absolutely spectacular and fluffy!

Better foliage has been a very long standing request, so have fun with this brand new toy.

[h1]Build freely[/h1]
Speaking of objects and long-standing feature requests—you can now [b]finally[/b] place trees and objects anywhere you'd be able to place a block. No more scaffolding, no more headaches. Just the freedom to build your dreams. Enjoy!

[h1]Everything seems to be in order[/h1]
The friend order in your telecharger will now remain fixed while the menu is open. This prevents accidentally telecharging to the wrong friend when someone just came online. Upon opening the menu, online friends are now always listed at the top. A small, but great UI improvement for everyone.

[h1]Home alone[/h1]
You can now play around with objects (like trees) in the 'Build alone' game mode. Finally! These behave identically to the online game mode, so you can experiment with different designs even when you're not able to play online.

notes.title: Angeldust v3.11 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.11:

[h1]Managed menagerie[/h1]
Angeldust v3.11 lets you summon a creature right from the in-game shop. For a small fee you can call any previously ridden or tamed creature back into existence. A great way to show off your exquisite animal collection:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/c40347fdd20430ece009d61269ec7ba4cd6539cf.jpg[/img]

As this totally [b]NOT Photoshopped®[/b] image shows, you:
[olist]
[*] buy the 'Summon a creature' action from the shop
[*] select the creature to spawn
[*] click the 'Summon' button to actually summon it
[/olist]
Literally as easy as 1, 2, 3.

[h1]I'll be watching you… even more![/h1]
The previous update introduced the 'Watch list' where you can monitor nearby player health and status. Angeldust v3.11 takes it one step further and shows all watched players on the world map, too:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/70ecb63729c16d8c5c7f99bb36c40128e3a577f8.jpg[/img]

Additionally, the world map will now continue to show the compass, the orientation bar and the watch list at the top of the screen. It's your one-stop shop for situational awareness.

[h1]Fast-ened Furious[/h1]
Ever found an extremely rare creature? Tried to hunt it, but accidentally pressed the E-key and rode it? Players have gone furious—and fast—due to this. So there's now a menu option to restrict the saddle to riding only your currently ridden creature:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/c7b68a158e9c6fb5f35c63083dc42f0eb8804413.jpg[/img]

You might already have noticed that the Angeldust v3.11 update addresses long-standing issues and frustrations. Thanks to [b]Hummm[/b], [b]ColtsWalker[/b], [b]obi-[/b], [b]Loki The Witful[/b] and others for reporting these.

[h1]"Type your message here."[/h1]
This catchphrase had become a meme in itself. Angeldust v3.11 updates the Angeldust website, PlayAngeldust.com, with proper text placeholders:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/9a926ad90fb05dafb60bd3d6b49ddbbcca765291.jpg[/img]

So yeah, [b]Alexi makarov[/b]—I went ahead and did it…

Even long-time Angeldust players didn't know that the E- and F-keys offer quick functionality in many in-game screens. Angeldust v3.11 introduces subtle hints to remind you of this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/c609107a580decfa397fe19f00d903f3f8ae0845.jpg[/img]

Hopefully this prevents you looking back in ten years and realizing [strike]she was into you all along[/strike] you could have sat, zoomed and filtered much quicker in Angeldust.

notes.title: Angeldust v3.10 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.10:

[h1]SITREP![/h1]
Angeldust v3.10 lets you… [b]sit[/b]! This very popular feature was first requested years ago. Of course you can sit in all visual styles:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/7a5d1be846d73db8d6fc971f828cdeeaaa4c4bf8.jpg[/img]

Sitting is available from the in-game 'Quick messages' menu. On a keyboard you can quickly sit by pressing F, then E. On a game controller, press the right action button, then D-pad UP:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/f6804bccf1a9456434aace5072358d4ddc73dd9f.gif[/img]

While sitting you can use the regular jump action to switch your legs between a flat or a seated pose. And using regular movement controls you can scoot over to get your character in the perfect position:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/c13ebaa7ee2307845c3df6634796ebe660906011.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dance the night away[/h1]
Pushing in-game self-expression even further, you can now also dance! As the first-ever Angeldust [i]pay-per-use[/i] item you simply hop over to the shop. Buy 'Dance' and you'll dance for at least 20 seconds to a new, celebratory fanfare.

What does it look like? Like fun! Try it out yourself ːsteamhappyː

(I'm [i]totally not[/i] trying to get you to buy things from the shop!)

[h1]First contact[/h1]
Angeldust v3.10 introduces the 'Contact manager' to watch, mute and chat with your contacts. Open it from the chat log or using the Y-key. The contact manager lets you easily manage your contacts, listed reverse-chronologically (names have been redacted for privacy purposes):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/fab277ac9bdda4c1bf2bd4e8adb436469a7b0c23.jpg[/img]

When a contact is muted, you will no longer see their chat messages, holo scroll texts and online status updates. Both muting and watching are temporary actions limited to your current gaming session.

[h1]I'll be watching you[/h1]
By 'watching' players in the contact manager you can add them to a new 'Watch list'. This watch list is visible right below the compass and directional guide at the top of the screen.

With the watch list you can easily track if players are nearby, along with their health and status (names have NOT been redacted here, so much for consistency):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/23d2d7c3fc9536b1c855062925d5c892badae245.jpg[/img]

[h1]How the turntables[/h1]
Don't ask how. Don't ask why. Angeldust v3.10 introduces what will forever be known as 'Reverse pots'. Place a column block above a tree or object and it will have a thicker bottom:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/92e4acb2828f3d883e91a25d8cdc509cd33e0bf9.jpg[/img]

Requested by [b]obi-[/b], only used by [b]obi-[/b] and probably only making sense in the mind of [b]obi-[/b]. There you go.

[h1]Network effect[/h1]
Angeldust v3.10 contains several improvements in the networking department. Reduced latency (lag), a fix for rare one-way communication scenarios and a much-improved network warning indicator. Hopefully you'll never notice Angeldust's netcode, but it's in the best shape it's ever been right now.

Thanks to [b]Hummm[/b] for helping out with lots of diagnostics.

[h1]Angeldust—Collector's Edition[/h1]
With Angeldust v3.10 you can select which ridden and tamed creature that you want to spawn with for each hero on the Angeldust website, PlayAngeldust.com.

The game now tracks all creatures you've ridden and tamed per hero, so you can build up quite a collection. In the future this will play a bigger role in the entire Angeldust experience.

[h1]That's a wrap![/h1]
One last cool, visual feature to mention is that the Angeldust chat log now sports text wrapping. Long lines of text will no longer be squashed together. Take a look at these choice quotes by [b]ColtsWalker[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/bd5b017975f86ad92272195d925abd01a171b203.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Angeldust v3.9 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.9:

[h1]All mime![/h1]
Angeldust v3.9 brings the "mimic" block which copies the appearance of a block below or above it. Mimics live in their own world, so other blocks are not affected by them. Complicated, but amazing!

The building possibilities and combinations have just exponentially increased. See this screenshot for some constructions that were previously impossible to create:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/44e105446a9a4c59df3a9d892869fea6e75d375d.jpg[/img]

Connect stairs to thin blocks, build walls out of panels, make individually tapered shapes, create beautiful practice dummies and make things climbable.

[h1]Meet your mimic[/h1]
There are two mimic blocks, here's what they look like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/e31e646bc52e8dd205b7b02c41076382c0d2c7fb.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/c6a95f96784856d520f244c0aca9221aeb9f7eee.png[/img]
[list]
[*] "Thin" mimic block: copies block below, shows top panel block element, is climbable
[*] "Full" mimic block: copies block above, shows middle panel block element, is not climbable
[/list]

Angeldust developer Firefly (that's me) shows the mimic block with many building tricks in this developer livestream video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cdsN1obB0OU

[h1]A bulldozer. Just what you need![/h1]
For eons players have asked for a better way to clear new land claims so they can start building on flat ground. Your wishes have been heard. Introducing the [b]bulldozer[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/6dff50e64698d31dab39d6862581ad44d76957b1.jpg[/img]

The bulldozer is a bull. And a dozer. All rolled into one. Before you fire it up you'll see a red bounding box denote the land claim you are about to flatten. Here are a few bulldozing tips:
[list]
[*] Only the builder hero can purchase and use the bulldozer
[*] The bulldozer only works in [b]your own[/b] claimed lands
[*] It only clears the naturally present terrain and trees
[*] You can stop the bulldozer using the detonator
[*] Bulldozers stop if an older device is physically nearby
[/list]

Firefly shows the bulldozer and a few other new tricks in this developer livestream video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PneGw72tZ-4

[h1]Gaming. Enhanced.[/h1]
Angeldust v3.9 tweaks hero gameplay to add more fun and variety. Fighters now get rewarded with a bit of health for nearby creature kills. Scouts will slightly heal while sprinting as a reward for being mobile and actually, well, scouting.

But be aware: the behavior and artificial intelligence of a few creatures has been enhanced to offer more challenge and diversity. Thanks to [b]Alexi makarov[/b] for some cool suggestions. I'd love to hear more from all of you.

[h1]Loudness wars[/h1]
[b]ColtsWalker[/b] asked for more granular main volume controls. So, here they are: you can now set Angeldust's main volume in increments of 10%. Especially handy on loud or noisy devices:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/bf4ee033b79a92b41de51265e37243ee742c0d1d.jpg[/img]

For reference, the old volume levels mapped to: 0% (Off), 33% (Low), 67% (Normal) and 100% (High).

[h1]That was left-handed![/h1]
In other news [b]ColtsWalker[/b] also asked for improved left-handed keyboard controls. You got it! [url=https://angeldu.st/en/controls]See the 'Controls' page on the Angeldust website[/url] for the full details.

[h1]Every claim you stake[/h1]
In even other news [b]ColtsWalker[/b] reported that claiming a land silently fails if you enter a description that is too long. So Angeldust v3.9 now shows you in bold, red text that your claim is going to fail:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/dd40116db34e72f55132b889642e3e7fc8b4d1fb.jpg[/img]

In hindsight, this update should probably have been called [b]The ColtsWalker™® Update[/b]. I'm open for suggestions from players with other player names too, though.

Just like nothing the game now uses about 20-25% less memory. Angeldust v3.8 also runs even smoother by offloading additional processing from the CPU to the GPU. This is the most feature-rich and fastest Angeldust you've ever seen.

notes.title: Angeldust v3.5 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.5:

[h1]We never go out of style[/h1]
With Angeldust v3.5 you can now easily choose between the "Cartoon" or "3D" visual style using the new style chooser:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/9c89b061eb32e7a5474eab33942c168735bf0f02.jpg[/img]

The visual style chooser pops up at first Angeldust start-up and can later be accessed using the language selection button on the sign-in form.

[h1]Quicker, smoother, better, faster[/h1]
Speaking of the "3D" visual style: it's been optimized a lot. Sprites now take up 33% less memory and render much faster thanks to precomputing detailed lighting information.

[h1]Sleeping village[/h1]
Big changes to the game world village this time around! First up: all house building plots (my technical term) are now made of woodchips and fully flush with the pavement:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/3532e6c611796a90af6ee120cf7ecd9626cc32fe.jpg[/img]

The woodchips add color to the village and thanks to the flush design it's easier to start building a tiny house (I'm hip!) where you don't get stuck in the floor. I've shoveled all the old gravel from inside the village to the pathways outside the village so new players can still easily discover both materials.

We now also have new and more detailed cupboards inside the village wall tool sheds. Courtesy of space is green (ignore the black void at the bottom :D):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/3facc155b225fedb92a49144ce1e1234c4812f65.jpg[/img]

[h1]Cellular control[/h1]
All of these changes were of course done using the new cell targeting crosshair in Angeldust v3.5. Bigger and better. It's transparent and gray when inactive, opaque and fully colored when active:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/c06dea1e4bda05e78abb7be5d6c166f2b76b9de1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Gonna make a change[/h1]
Big news: Angeldust now stores more incremental backups of all land claims in the game. Firefly (that's-a me!) managed to load in about 120 backups of the game world, going back all the way to four days after the Angeldust v1.0 (pre-Steam!) launch day.

I hope to use this new functionality to create beautiful timelapse videos of the in-game wonders. More on this soon (hopefully)!

notes.title: Angeldust v3.4 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.4:

[h1]Paint it black[/h1]
Introducing: holo painter! This block allows you to set a color scheme that will be applied to any hero stepping on it. You can currently select eight unique color schemes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/99c44b556cad87e88cf87bf2190b525e6a21c2b4.jpg[/img]

Use this block to visually split groups of heroes into teams, or make them adhere to the dress code for your house, castle or other build. Players can revert to their regular outfit by activating the holo painter a second time.

[h1]Punching in the numbers[/h1]
When placing a holo painter, holo charger, photon block or photon imitator you can now use the mouse scroll wheel, the right analog stick on a game controller, or on-screen buttons to select the desired numeric entry:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/4609811dbd40f12a4b238442d70e48f46f94a65e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Be picky[/h1]
Angeldust v3.4 brings two brand new building tools—the first being the 'block picker'. This pipette (or eye dropper tool) allows you to select a block and identify it. Switch to the block picker using the 'Q' key on the keyboard, or the left bumper button on a game controller.

'Use' the block picker to equip the selected block from your inventory. Neat:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/af768764ffc86802fd9231ea3dc29f600ad6a59d.jpg[/img]

You can also use the block picker to inspect building techniques used by other players. Hover over blocks and see how they interact.

[h1]Ze goggles, zey do nothing![/h1]
On top of to the block picker come the spiffy new goggles. And 'zey' certainly do something! Use the goggles to enable or disable a nifty cell targeting grid so see where you can and can not place or remove blocks:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/496af1dc8fa07e0bb78c35b7f0cca4c3ca1376aa.jpg[/img]

The grid remains active until disabled by using the goggles a second time. When equipped, the goggles also hide the compass, in-game control hints and the hotbar will squeeze to half its size so you can more clearly look around.

Both the block picker and the goggles are available from the in-game item shop for a token amount of coins. So fork over your cash and get some nice building tools today!

[h1]Save me, save me, save me![/h1]
Because I just [b]know[/b] that players are going to like the super cute, itty-bitty hotbar when using the goggles, you can now also permanently have a halved hotbar by setting the options menu 'text size' option to the new, lowest value of 'space-saving'.

The 'text size' option is available on Windows, macOS and Linux.

[h1]Range revolution[/h1]
Angeldust v3.4 almost doubles the effective range of blocks, trees, your shovel and your axe. This makes building way more comfortable. Take a look at the almost silly range:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/126182409995207f7763cf647d588a341feed701.jpg[/img]

It might not be fully realistic (well, what is?), but it allows for a much more [b]fun[/b] building experience. Combined with the block picker you can now just space out and build your dreams. Indirectly placing block by nudging them into empty spaces ('bridging') is also still possible.

Your targeting crosshair is now always visible to improve your pointing accuracy. This helps a lot. Try it. You'll like it!

[h1]Functional bunch[/h1]
Conveyor belts have tiny arrows on them in Angeldust v3.4. The trampoline loses its metal frame and has a better animation. Surprisingly, I can now share the direction of conveyor belts in a static screenshot. Lo and behold (with cute hotbar):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/15bb7df21b15e6b638a76a4220da59adb950d904.jpg[/img]

[h1]Touch of gold[/h1]
Hard to visualize, but the entire touchscreen control interface has been revamped. New icons for common functionality, context-aware buttons to help out with building and dedicated action buttons instead RSI-inducing tap-and-hold mechanics. It's pretty good!

[h1]"Developer of the game", I choose you![/h1]
Just like summoning your favorite, cutely-spelled, imaginary pet from a red-and-white ball, you can now choose which of your badges you want to show in-game and on the Angeldust website. Go to the 'Account details' page of [url=http://PlayAngeldust.com]PlayAngeldust.com[/url] and choose wisely:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/4815de77752a98bd5d479b37a518bd34c5c525a1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hole in my life[/h1]
The ever prolific obi2002 reported that panels placed in between some girder blocks rendered with holes between them. This is now fixed, as evident in my very, very imaginative build here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/34342b7f7d3b4de11978a4bae920c9937ea21ea8.jpg[/img]

[h1]I'll sign for that![/h1]
Big news: the sign-in form now shows the forest in the background instead of the empty village. This adds a splash of color and recognizability to the sign-in form, which is the first thing that new players see. Mucho importante:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/e1ceb0c57d07e5d0d52288f6c60dc901ad462d30.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quicker, smoother, better, faster[/h1]
For Angeldust v3.4 I've optimized disk I/O a lot. Especially if you're playing with a regular HDD (instead of an SSD) and at higher view distances you should notice much better performance when moving between game world areas.

In addition to performance improvements Angeldust will now strike a better balance between showing distant areas and updating nearby blocks when building. This reduces building latency while also rendering distant things earlier so your world feels more complete.

[*]Fix and optimize butterfly and firefly rendering
[*]Improve background ground plane aesthetics
[*]Tweak in-game displayed hero level resolution and range
[*]Fix Android crashes related to device configuration changes

notes.title: Angeldust v3.3 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.3:

[h1]Beam my baby[/h1]
After years of fan requests, horizontal [b]girder blocks[/b] are now available for building in Angeldust. And they're glorious:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/b191650426a952a4f3c24511ec9dc4c25e60c149.jpg[/img]

You can buy girder blocks from the in-game shop just like any other block. Girder blocks come in all existing vertical column variants as well as three new designs for Angeldust v3.3!

Girder blocks will vertically snap to panel blocks so you can make new and interesting designs. Hopefully a bit more pleasing than this example screenshot:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/ca3df87ae368920b57155db270c092aca0bf3782.jpg[/img]

The village walls have also been updated to include girder blocks as decoration:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/22bb650a95701f718a7ac4482339c0965d66690c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Atmospheric lighting[/h1]
To accentuate game world contours and depth Angeldust v3.3 features improved atmospheric light that simulates humidity and dampness. The results are stunning:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/2edbd1c0c0f91ff921cf17eb9fde953fd9cdf8de.jpg[/img]

This new lighting model is enabled on all operating systems and devices at no performance cost.

[h1]Mr. Wonderful[/h1]
When visiting the many wonders of Angeldust using the telecharger you will now see the wonder's name and its builder. Wonders are now rotated in sequential order and the total number of available wonders is shown:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/0d930460af02cd47524b70141a6fae6b6ce314bb.jpg[/img]

These changes make wonders feel more, well, wonderful and allow you to easily send a friend request to wonder builders.

[h1]Photon imitator—create-a-creature[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/1ee5d346f0b3ea47bcbb0acc6a11f676675340b2.png[/img]
The photon imitator spawns a creature of your liking when triggered by a photon. You can spawn almost any type of creature that you've discovered in the game world to create a (petting) zoo, museum or battle arena.

The imitated, holographic creatures have a distinct yellow/white glow and will not be able to affect the game world. Outside of the village imitated creatures will interact and attack you when provoked, so be careful!

When an imitated creature is killed, it drops a photon ball. You can use this mechanic to build arenas where fighting is mandatory to progress. Imitated creatures do not give rewards or quest progress.

[h1]Photon counter—what's the count?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/982464e55496c06fdf71fd681234394001ab574c.png[/img]
The photon counter counts the number of photon passing by it, from 0 up to 9. Then it wraps back to 0 while dropping a photon ball. Use the photon counter to create visual displays and 'loops' like in any programming language.

The game world village now includes a photon counter demo machine to illustrate some of its use cases.

[h1]More photon goodness[/h1]
Photon balls no longer de-spawn when devices are nearby and vice-versa. Photon balls will now magnetize to conveyor belts so you can more easily build drop zones that trigger by photon ball:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/9b049130da75a7cd6ecd4b6154fed306a41c9233.jpg[/img]

Photon blocks will now always play a sound and spawn a spark shower when triggered by a photon so you know that a block got activated. If the desired effect doesn't take place there is a precondition not being met.

[h1]Tree's company[/h1]
Angeldust v3.3 ships with oft-requested 'tree bark' blocks that you can use to create things looking like tree bark. Wow:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/52349bedcc63e0b0bea5e64e283f64e3e9503e8a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hol' up![/h1]
Holo blocks, the photon injector and photon remover now make a very audible and satisfying 'click' sound when activated. This gives much better feedback of your in-game actions. Thanks to everyone suggesting this feature, it makes life much better.

[h1]What you see is what you get[/h1]
The block construction interface now properly renders transparent and multilayered materials. So finally your in-hand water barrel looks like a water barrel. Why didn't I think of this earlier?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/733322cbe5ccdede6dce155dacd8bd44c3f57616.jpg[/img]

[h1]Launch time[/h1]
Angeldust v3.3 includes a cute little 'launch trail' animation when heroes get launched into the air by springs, trampolines, photon blocks, creature attacks, Sky Walk and more. Here it's caught in all its glory on [url=https://www.youtube.com/AngeldustLive]Angeldust Live![/url]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26892681/6c5249a793a988c4f21c3364f5894651adf6f12b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Angeldust PostFX for Windows[/h1]
You might already know that you can [url=https://metagaming.itch.io/angeldust]download Angeldust PostFX for Windows[/url] to spice up your in-game graphics. Angeldust v3.3 is now fully compatible with the post-processing add-on, resulting in beautiful scenes everywhere.

View Firefly's livestreams on [url=https://www.youtube.com/AngeldustLive]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/AngeldustLive]Twitch[/url] to see it in action!

[h1]Security shame[/h1]
Shortly after the release of Angeldust v3.3 I received a bug report about not being able to send the '%' character in private and friend chat messages. I instantly recognized this for the security issue it was (an [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uncontrolled_format_string]uncontrolled format string[/url] attack). 20 minutes later I had patched the server to prevent player crashes.

Since then I've audited the entire Angeldust source code and put protections in place to prevent this kind of bug from ever resurfacing. The attack was limited to this one instance. As far as I can check in the log files no players other than a willing test subject have been affected by the issue.

The upcoming Angeldust v3.4 update will re-enable the '%' character in private and friend chat messages. Thanks to obi2002 and others for reporting the issue.

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix world map hero sprite rendering artifacts
[*]Improve 3D sprite rotational rendering accuracy
[*]Polish particle shower effects
[*]Don't render stray dust circles for empty photon blocks
[*]Expand standalone game mode block collection
[*]Hide chat strings when placing customized blocks

notes.title: Angeldust v3.2 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.2:

[h1]Put your faith in the light![/h1]
Angeldust v3.2 brings a whole new category of fun and interactive building tools: [b]photon blocks[/b]. Use photon blocks to build automated machinery and gadgets like doors, key locks, music boxes, elevators and much more!

The game world village contains new demo machines to showcase some of the photon block functionality:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/3cccb141e5e0750dd03c73ff3c1aa70115d73f68.jpg[/img]

[h1]Light my way[/h1]
Get photon blocks from the in-game shop for a relatively modest price and spice up your buildings:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/d42dc227ab23c6d1c228e6415c133cd1a4acbca2.jpg[/img]

The set of photon blocks consists of:
[list]
[*][b]Photon injector[/b]: spawns 'toggler' photons (star-shaped particles) to activate machines
[*][b]Photon conduit[/b]: allows photons to travel around, split and loop
[*][b]Photon block[/b]: toggles on and off to create game world effects
[*][b]Photon faucet[/b]: wraps photons in photon balls (bubbles) bouncing in the game world
[*][b]Photon remover[/b]: spawns 'resetter' photons to deactivate and reset machines
[/list]

Angeldust creator 'Firefly' shows off an early version of photon blocks in action on a previous YouTube live stream (at about 2:11:00):
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gzaIvArAbaU&t=7900

[h1]Photon injector—start me up[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/4eab155701bb45681af1528ca2bb8ff0fcc78a9a.png[/img]

The photon injector—when stepped on—spawns 'toggler' photons on all sides that have either a photon conduit or a photon block. Star-shaped toggler photons make photon blocks toggle between their 'on' and 'off' state.

[h1]Photon conduit—sizzling circuits[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/1c4e8e54ba043a47b9887702ff4577c2563a9458.png[/img]

Photons travel inside photon conduits. Build elaborate circuits using the photon conduit to make T-splits, loops and timing devices. Photon blocks next to the conduit will be triggered by photons inside the conduit.

[h1]Photon block—multitalented rockstar[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/54cf2cf483615caa5ed9a52750b48531c935d590.png[/img]

The photon block is the main interactive photon element. Place photon blocks next to, or in line with, photon conduits to make the functional part of your machines or devices.

Photon blocks can toggle between an 'off' and 'on' state. When doing so, the block exhibits several different behaviors:
[list]
[*]toggle between physically non-blocking ('off') and blocking ('on'), so you can make doors;
[*]toggle between light-emitting ('on') or not ('off'), to make interactive lamps and lighting;
[*]produce a (user-customizable) sound like a click, percussion, bass or musical notes, to make melodies;
[*]throw heroes in the air when switching from the 'off' to 'on' state, so you can make elevators.
[/list]

When a photon block is placed in line between two photon conduit blocks it will act as a switch and only toggle from its 'off' to 'on' state, not vice-versa.

[h1]Photon faucet—balls of light[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/20f2cf8867927cb0c5d854fa01eeb3f70ed80878.png[/img]

The photon faucet wraps photons in a bouncing 'photon ball' that can be manipulated in the game world by heroes, conveyor belts and trampolines. The photon ball triggers photon blocks, photon injectors and photon removers. It dissolves when touching water.

You can use the photon faucet and photon ball to build interactive mini-games and puzzles. [b]obi2002[/b] built a fantastic 'photon ball' stadium with the help of other players:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/e33e324889fa3c060b4b845a150c11984f4e1d73.jpg[/img]

[h1]Photon remover—clearing the way[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/1da96fda6cb9211a7d7d94e7d8c28277234c97bc.png[/img]

The photon remover spawns 'remover' photons on all its sides containing a photon conduit or photon block. These photons will travel through photon conduits and set any connected photon blocks to their 'off' state. Use the photon remover to reset machinery to a known-good starting state.

[h1]Walls of [strike]steel[/strike] wonder[/h1]
The game world village walls have been redecorated, based on a new design by [b]space is green[/b]. So in addition to the new photon block demo machines, the village now feels [i]very fresh[/i]:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/4e758c1101b6203062c4338b0cb35ca22f7be953.jpg[/img]

[h1]Smoke and a pancake[/h1]
Millions of players asked for improved visuals when placing smoke on top of a column block. If this is not to your liking, [i]then there is no pleashing you[/i]:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/c25174781e73315b2d708220d2a9140619dc9abd.jpg[/img]

[h1]That's hot. Times three.[/h1]
Another specially requested feature: adding a third hotbar for inventory management. Available now, in three different colors:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/1efd6ff2f6ca49e5c219cfa75e3adaf0b242d0af.jpg[/img]

Use the keyboard tilde (~) or Alt-/Option-key, your game controller's D-pad up and down, or swipe left-to-right over the inventory grid icon on a touchscreen to switch between different hotbars.

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]

[*]Remove quest creature type health bar highlight when quest is completed
[*]Raise chat indicator text balloon above heroes riding a creature
[*]Show a 'descend' touchscreen button when flying on a drakeling
[*]Improve Android device compatibility and stability

[/list]

notes.title: Angeldust v3.1 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.1:

[h1]One picture—a thousand words[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/bcb0e455a98657b9e4e443ab60fdbcc6ca0d132e.jpg[/img]

[i]Of course[/i] I'm flying on a drakeling. [i]Of course[/i] we now have MXAO, ambient light, depth-of-field (DoF) and FXAA. [i]Of course[/i] this is amazing!

[h1]Angeldust PostFX[/h1]
Our [url=https://metagaming.itch.io/angeldust]Itch.io page[/url] now lists an 'Angeldust PostFX for Windows' download containing an official OpenGL shader add-on for Angeldust. Currently available for Windows 7 and up, it greatly enhances the graphics:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/0dc53ff33216806f36b8dea7b968540a896f0a33.jpg[/img]

You will need a solid desktop-class GPU to run Angeldust PostFX, but I'm sure you'll like the new ambient occlusion, ambient light, depth-of-field and anti-aliasing effects! Just wear sunglasses to prevent snow blindness:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/1a79b96c0c7fbbc9c101dc2ea6b83c6059867152.jpg[/img]

Major thanks to 'Alex makarov' who suggested the idea for making an Angeldust PostFX add-on. And he helped out greatly with finding a solid initial solution.

[h1]Angeldust Ultra 2D Sprite Pack[/h1]
In addition to the Angeldust PostFX add-on, there's a new sprite pack to enable the Ultra detail level for 2D sprites. You'll need about 6 GiB of video ram (VRAM) to run this, but everything looks pretty sharp using it!

[h1]My kingdom for a dragon![/h1]
If you have the donator badge (or up) you can now fly around on the drakelings in the game. If that isn't awesome enough, there are even more donation incentives now:
[list]
[*]instant access to the 'pet snack' to tame creatures
[*]a brand new, cheesy 'cheese' block
[*](just to remind you:) you can fly dragons!
[*]exclusive, new colors for your heroes:
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/7d4b5d0df9556cba1cd3a4c0bea4a706b9d0db44.jpg[/img]

[h1]Weekend rockstars[/h1]
Angeldust v3.0 brought daily quests. Angeldust v3.1 brings weekend quests! Every weekend, during the entire weekend, you'll have to hunt creatures that are more difficult to find and kill. See if you can rise up to the challenge!

For example, today (as of writing), we're trying to hunt… uhhh… [i]this thing[/i]:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/4f145585c5a1898799f642dc13fa39d79346bcff.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bust a move![/h1]
More graphical improvements: heroes, ridden creatures and pets now have movement trails. This way you can more easily see where others are going and what's happening around you:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/dacae92e2a813329740e14d1bfdb8cbb2b2000a4.jpg[/img]

Thanks to 'Alex makarov' (again) for posing handsomely.

[h1]Sparks in your eyes[/h1]
Angeldust v3.1 brings totally awesome spark showers. We already had these in the main user interface, but now you'll see sparks flying around in the game world too.

These sparks celebrate joyful events like heroes leveling up, discovering new creatures, materials or trees and progressing on your quest. For instance, I don't know what happened here, but it's very joyful. Many spark. Wow!:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/ebfaa4919e60a307e0fd1393784c0be76ce779c6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Don't get off your high horse[/h1]
Quick note: you can now use the shovel, axe, blocks and trees while riding a creature. This is especially cool (hint hint!) while flying on a drakeling since you can now easily navigate in 3D and build to your heart's content.

[h1]Make things better[/h1]
Builders: pay attention! In Angeldust v3.1 you can upgrade your devices! Just keep swinging your hammer on the device as if you were repairing it. If you get a critical hit, the device will become more powerful. So, swing on:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/a0901717ff45d77c8d0b1aece79db7ef96198d13.jpg[/img]

[h1]Telecharger. Turbocharged![/h1]
The telecharger has changed almost completely. Location load/save buttons are visually connected now. Friends take up an entire row and buttons now have icons for building permission, private chat and world location:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/cdc36b6de2078323ed9e51c16890570c9c5be584.jpg[/img]

In addition, if you are currently in one of your claimed lands, the button will be highlighted in yellow.

[h1]Chatception[/h1]
You might have wondered… private chat? Yes! Angeldust v3.1 comes with private chat (1-on-1) and friend chat (all online friends). Enter a private chat by clicking on the text balloon next to a friend's name.

You can enter friend chat mode by toggling the new, uppermost button in the chat log:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/f52d6d95b0b79f081a7df26cf933e39c361ce609.jpg[/img]

[h1]Every claim you stake[/h1]
Big news! In Angeldust v3.1 you can name your land claims. You can manage land claim descriptions on the Angeldust website at PlayAngeldust.com, and while claiming new land:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/818c4d852b6749a8f8775e6a4f47e1522a954e70.jpg[/img]

The telecharger and holo charger will show land claim names:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/49512c418bedd70cf9a729fff3755cb9667a277a.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/2d1a725e1958b24345b6278492db944421990ac4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Solid performance[/h1]
Angeldust v3.1 ships with a completely re-architected rendering path. Mainly to support the Angeldust PostFX add-on, but also to majorly improve rendering performance. Here's a technical list of changes:
[list]
[*]increase 2D sprite resolution for smoother animations and movement
[*]speed up weather particle (rain, snow) lighting performance four-fold
[*]switch to a single, per-frame depth-buffer pass
[*]improve vertex shader level-of-detail thresholds
[*]optimize entity door detection and door sound tracking
[/list]

[h1]Understated overdraw[/h1]
I've also found the time to (finally) implement something that's been on my wish-list for years. 2D sprites are now rendered with less overdraw. Previously heroes would be rendered up to ten times over, pushing GPUs to their limit.

Now only the visible areas of sprites are rendered, reducing GPU load from 1300% to less than 100% for complex sprites. Here's what the GPU now sees. Kind of:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/25a96bb84b9dbdf1157c5e2407673dd5b4c16ea1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Legen… wait for it… dary. Right.[/h1]
There are two new very rare, very legendary creatures in Angeldust v3.1. But you'll probably never find them. Just thought you should know.

[h1]Count on me[/h1]
Speaking of legendary discoveries. Over the years some players have reported not being awarded creature kills in rare cases. I've found the root cause and finally fixed this problem once and for all.

So if you do manage to find those very rare, legendary creatures that you'll never find, you will always be awarded the discovery bonus and additional goodies.

[h1]Moar blox[/h1]
Angeldust v3.1 comes with a boatload of new blocks: orange marble doors, opaque wooden doors, clouds, smoke and thick smoke.

'space is green' is decking out his awesome tower with smoke and cloud blocks. They bubble and puff quite nicely. And I'm totally NOT trying to show off flying on a drakeling (donate!) and Angeldust PostFX:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/14c6e3165d1a2a957ccf20ea42db7f61db9dbf7d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Good, old-fashioned love![/h1]
For everyone playing in the 'old-fashioned' visual style: everything now looks much crisper thanks to a nicer texture filter. In the future I might improve this even more, but for now it looks pretty decent:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/6f1e7c3d617be249408fdd91e1c5072aee568370.jpg[/img]

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ridden creatures no longer follow heroes
[*]Pets wait in the regular game world when entering The Void / Hero battle!
[*]Improved user interface control highlighting
[*]Fix keyboard and game controller user interface navigation away from filter buttons
[*]Added in-game tips on 'world' location, build permissions, taming and donating
[*]'R'-key now both opens and closes the telecharger
[*]Support even more game controller models
[/list]

[h1]Be social![/h1]
If you like Angeldust, please write a positive review on Steam! You can also stalk us everywhere. Thanks in advance:
[list]
[*]Steam reviews: http://steamcommunity.com/app/488440/positivereviews/?browsefilter=mostrecent
[*]Developer live stream: https://www.youtube.com/AngeldustLive
[*]Twitch channel: https://www.twitch.tv/AngeldustLive
[*]Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/AngeldustLive
[*]Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playangeldust/
[*]Twitter: https://twitter.com/AngeldustLive
[*]Community Discord server: https://discord.gg/m8FekP3
[/list]

notes.title: Angeldust v3.0 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v3.0:

[h1]We're 3D now boys and girls![/h1]
A beautiful, new 3D visual style is now the default on desktop platforms after lots of testing in Early Access. This new style demands a new trailer, so here's the brand new 3D Angeldust trailer on YouTube:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cP2th7gFdTQ

[h1]Paint me a picture[/h1]
There's dozens of new screenshots everywhere, professionally localized into eight languages. Here are two great cinematic snaps. There are a load more on the Steam store page and the Angeldust website, PlayAngeldust.com:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/412f54854a175d381164ee24f448d826e9a885a7.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/d1cc847581509edd5f9870c01024b6fd731bcdfe.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quests 'r' Us[/h1]
Angeldust now features daily quests. Each day you can hunt a specific creature to receive a reward and increase your rank on the all-new quest completion leaderboard. On first sign in, you'll get a new hint:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/7a91521f99680cbe64ec3a1dfa2df9f0b6443f75.jpg[/img]

You can always view your current quest on the world map, accessible from the telecharger and using the 'M'-key:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/6600d98a3a0954f4b099dddf3e983e161326fa44.jpg[/img]

Competition for the top spot on the quest leaderboard is currently very fierce, so try your best to complete your quest every day if you aim to be number one!

[h1]Sgt. Petter's Lonely Hearts Clu—whatever![/h1]
Bad puns aside, you can now have your very own pets in Angeldust. Each of your heroes can tame a small creature using the new 'pet snack' item that is given to players with the donator badge and up.

The pet snack will automatically show up in your inventory. Use it on a creature of your liking to tame it. Here you can see some pets and the pet snack in the hotbar (in the vibrant 'Cartoon' visual style with new artwork):

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/dd6809f993d1ef106984004de99718c68207f580.jpg[/img]

You've probably already seen the new trailer's ending shot, but for those who missed it, it features a fighter with a dog pet. Feels good man:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/76846522929d643bc5e433b255a0aa5f81a4a364.jpg[/img]

[h1]Winner, winner, pet snack dinner![/h1]
Want a pet? Don't want to donate? You're in luck! Frank "Firefly" Lucas, the creator of Angeldust, hosts a very special Angeldust lottery every livestream on YouTube and Twitch.

Enter your ticket to participate in the lottery and maybe you are the next player to win the all-new 'lottery winner' badge that gives you the pet snack item.

Subscribe, follow and check out:
https://youtube.com/angeldustlive
https://twitch.tv/AngeldustLive

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/df2364e1504cf6a58bc6e1fd13b11e8db5d213a9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Take your best shot![/h1]
Angeldust v3.0 introduces a PvP-leaderboard listing your Hero battle!-score. Find out how many points you got for shooting others and compare your performance with your friends! Use the sorting buttons on top of the leaderboard to access all statistics:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/5f6596c373baeca3b8e96cef4ff4a43cbaecd5d5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Buy my T-shirt, please![/h1]
Yup. Y'all asked for it. We now sell official Angeldust merchandise. Mugs, shirts, posters, stickers, device cases, pillows. The only thing missing is mouse pads. Coming soon, hopefully! Check out the merchandise here:
https://www.redbubble.com/people/MetagamingBV/shop/recent

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/ffb262ef6899f92a9ea8e926237a90e9f014d533.jpg[/img]

[h1]Performance matters[/h1]
The entire build toolchain and underlying frameworks for Angeldust have been updated. 64-bit support is improved. Angeldust now features level-of-detail for distant game world elements and you can set your view distance to three new, "very distant" distances. Enabling scenes like these:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/f67eb7be25050309d5e3874b5af7d30f0e4da57c.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/79ad712fa7a2886de5bf69c00ddfbc968d8c4d76.jpg[/img]

Not only has the maximal view distance greatly increased, it now also renders more accurately, preventing flicker even in complex scenes. Check out this beautifully layered forest shot:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/c42de1006ce120ad72a0f71d7c345fac18278fe9.jpg[/img]

Talking about rendering, there no longer are weird texture holes in distant geometry. Here's a screenshot of the problem that is now fixed:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/5e1c036cd2d194ce77f3a4731daff77918a50967.jpg[/img]

[h1]I want the small one![/h1]
Continuing our story about rendering improvements—Android users will no longer see missing walls or floors. And performance on iOS is greatly improved. Here's a comparison shot of Android rendering with and without missing walls:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/11ddad96debe16974eaf989d74b85e779f6da90c.gif[/img]

The Android build of Angeldust now also supports accessing notifications, the system menu and even switching apps. Reported crash rate is now very close to zero in practice. It's now always a good day to play Angeldust on Android. Or as Android—whatever floats your boat.

[h1]Blocks and bushes to battle boredom[/h1] 
There's more than a dozen new blocks, and six new bushes that you can all buy from the in-game shop to spice up your builds. Enjoy new combinations of colors and block styles:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/4dd8637970314ce05f33f1e500b22afbc5008aa4.jpg[/img]

[h1]More social[/h1]
The Angeldust sign-in form now features three additional social media links, and also show your pet! Here are all social media links:
YouTube—https://www.youtube.com/AngeldustLive
Twitch—https://www.twitch.tv/AngeldustLive
Facebook—https://www.facebook.com/AngeldustLive
Instagram—https://www.instagram.com/playangeldust/
Discord—https://discord.gg/m8FekP3
Twitter—https://twitter.com/AngeldustLive

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/5020ec8c7e8972627e406bf56d17e2eb56e1fa11.jpg[/img]

[h1]Creature-own adventure[/h1]
With the addition of pets comes another slew of creature-related features. The intelligence of your horse, moa or bear has been improved so that it now follows you at a distance. Hopefully you won't ever lose your mount again!

You can now also abandon your mount or your pet from the Angeldust website, PlayAngeldust.com

[h1]Hammer Time! (I can do this all day)[/h1]
The builder hero can now use his hammer to repair in-game devices to extend their lifespan. Just swing your hammer at whatever thing you want to repair and it'll be good for another lifetime:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/a0901717ff45d77c8d0b1aece79db7ef96198d13.jpg[/img]

[h1]Badger, badger, mushroom, mushroom[/h1]
We now have (GM) / game master player accounts to help out new players. To make sure you are dealing with a real GM, the telecharger will now list player badges:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/80c2f307a7ca658bdbe79b2eb8b4268731cdc362.jpg[/img]

[h1]Privacy matters[/h1]
Metagaming B.V. (Angeldust's publisher) no longer stores your e-mail address. Instead, a cryptographically secure hash value is stored and used when resetting your password. All old e-mail address information has been scrubbed from the Angeldust database.

The Angeldust website at PlayAngeldust.com has also been cleaned from any tracking code, old cruft and legacy code. It's faster and more beautiful than ever before. And it now also lists item type descriptions and hints!

[h1]Tinker toys[/h1]
Are you an advanced Angeldust user or content creator? There are three new settings files you can add to your Angeldust settings folder:
[list]
[*][b]window_width.txt[/b] — enter the width (in points) for the Angeldust window
[*][b]window_height.txt[/b] — same as above, for window height
[*][b]anti_aliasing_samples.txt[/b] — set the MSAA / anti-aliasing level (2 / 4 / 8 …)
[/list]

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]'R'-key now opens up the telecharger
[*]Added 'huge' third-person view distance
[*]Fix trees/objects sinking into panel blocks
[*]Improved 'The Void' / Hero battle! status message wording
[*]Fixed rare quick messages menu disconnection bug
[*]Ignore biome discoveries when in wonders / claimed land
[*]Fix saddle shortcut sometimes triggering a 'quick shovel' action
[*]Fix house demolition leaving tiny trees or garbage

[*]Fix frozen hotbar after entering The Void with second hotbar selected
[*]Fix hand-painted visual style flat, corroded steel metal texture
[*]Fix column block face visibility calculation
[*]Added additional in-game tips
[*]Make the saddle shortcut ('E'-key, top action button, saddle button) skip forward during game replay playback
[*]Added 'following' cinematic camera mode
[*]Fix V-sync not being properly initialized at start up
[*]Increase highest discoverable creature level
[*]Fix incorrect item selected after opening and closing world map
[*]Fix world map not showing after standing still for a longer time
[*]Support even more game controller models
[/list]

[h1]Be social![/h1]
If you like Angeldust, please write a positive review on Steam! You can also stalk us everywhere. Thanks in advance:
