notes.title: Angeldust v2.24 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v2.24:

[h1]The world is still not enough[/h1]
This is a biggie. For eons players have asked for a better way to navigate the world. BOOM! A spiffy world map is now easily accessibly using the 'M' key and from the telecharger:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/f55ac3c67652b137431f0197faf37f8e467edb1b.jpg[/img]

Tons of details went into the map: your actual hero is shown rotated towards your viewing direction. It has a trail of the path you took. Shows new areas, materials and trees that you can unlock. Has coordinates (ooh, shiny!). You can zoom in and out to ludicrous levels. Have fun charting a course and watching your builds from above!

[h1]Holo there![/h1]
Angeldust v2.24 adds two new interactive blocks: the holo scroll and the holo charger. The former one allows you to add messages in the game world that players can read when stepping upon the block. The holo charger block lets players teleport to your land claims:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/7a2d261e2706c3e61d04b9b3c261e43c05d92e08.jpg[/img]

[h1]Привет![/h1]
While on the topic of messages: the Russian translation of Angeldust has been completely revised and edited by a small team of community volunteers. Thanks to Alex Makarov, Noddrog and konorpwnz for doing a stellar job!

[h1]Tutorials and tips[/h1]
To help new players on their way in the (sometimes) dangerous world of Angeldust, there are now a multitude of tutorials and tips that pop up in the beginning:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/43c6f61c19499e89394d34c8e3179614899564ba.jpg[/img]

You'll now also see item descriptions in the shop. Hurray for progress!

[h1]Windows 64-bit support[/h1]
Angeldust now runs in 64-bit mode on Windows. Many bits. Much wow. In practice this means way better performance, support for 'ultra' detail textures and potentially support for even higher view distances. Enjoy!

[h1]There's a hole in my life[/h1]
The Angeldust PvP area called 'The Void' has been updated visually. Here's a quick preview:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/d9057c2457698f0b673870fa10f8619e65c42176.jpg[/img]

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix level-up message level calculation for high levels
[*]Switch order of account badge and flag to be consistent
[*]Render account badges in more parts of the UI
[*]Add 'cherry blossom' and 'autumn leaves' trees to the shop

notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v2.23:

[h1]Big entrance[/h1]
The sign-in form has been completely redesigned and is now tailored to your hero colors and the creature you last rode. You'll feel right at home when playing:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/2d8c5676f8f8e538834c1b5d331500d20d84215c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Return from limbo[/h1]
Speaking of big entrances: sometimes your Wi-Fi drops out. Sometimes a cat yanks your network cable. We've all been there (me too). You'd end up in limbo in the game. Not disconnected, but not being able to play. Angeldust v2.23 implements immediate reconnection so you can sign-in without having to wait a few minutes. Nifty!

[h1]Badge news bears[/h1]
This update brings account badges so you can see who's boss in-game and on the Angeldust website. The full list of badges is explained on the support page. Here's a quick preview:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/b0d60c257a6706675c9a91136e00721c43887c3d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hero battle![/h1]
Everyone's been asking for PvP in Angeldust since close to forever. It's here! Battle other heroes in a new game world area called The Void:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/253516f3b61d24a05df27c82c3eeb2026fee0566.jpg[/img]

Try to make it to the top of the leaderboard! Rewards and persistent rankings will come in the future.

[h1]Hotter bar[/h1]
Oft requested: you can now switch to a second row of hotbar icons using the 'Alt' or '~' key and D-Pad up or down. The contents of the hotbar are now also saved so you can pick up where you left off. This makes building and fighting a lot easier as you'll always have the tools you need where you left them. Always Be Knolling.

[h1]New blocks[/h1]
This update adds a lot of community-requested blocks: cobwebs, colored hedges, stretched cloth, new cloth colors, rope nets, colored glass:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/088fad244b6ad9200b64e3d4d01d88ead7b6618d.jpg[/img]

Angeldust will now show level-up messages for nearby heroes. And you. So you can all exchange GGs in style. And right on time. GG!

Angeldust v2.23 now shows area discovery progress in in-game announcements and the progress overview. This'll help you track your progress even better:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/13d811a35649893dcc8b6de03f20084e25b0e236.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Angeldust v2.22 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v2.22:

[h1]Depth charge[/h1]
Ever felt like the Angeldust game world was lacking in depth? Meet 'ambient occlusion' (AO) that accentuates contours and edges. Check this animation of moebius' new build with and without AO:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/1e4a2dcdd5cc8dab14d8f833e0bb83971b78685e.gif[/img]

Ambient occlusion dials up the realism and visual impact of Angeldust to eleven. It's enabled on all operating systems, devices and PlayAngeldust.com so your buildings look sharp everywhere!

[h1]umop apisdn (upside down)[/h1]
Stairs no longer form weird shapes in places where you don't want them. Instead they will now form upside-down slopes that follow predictable lines. Finally you can build nice roofs like these:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/2bbe3bbedac0786848e6da345f586816c730da04.jpg[/img]

[h1]Music for your plants[/h1]
A few updates we introduced being able to discover and plant trees. Now you can finally give them a proper welcome. Column blocks will now taper to accommodate trees above. Music. For your plants:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/9dfc2d2ae64a06dc1531283db99da6a086f68657.jpg[/img]

[h1]Why the long face?[/h1]
OK, one more quick building improvement: panel blocks on top of thin blocks will now stretch downwards. Make windowsills, tall windows and more never-before-seen stuff:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/e71c58694e970f5a440a5c0b9b35d7f32f99d7bb.jpg[/img]

[h1]All are welcome[/h1]
Angeldust now also (finally) supports registering a new account right from within the game. As of writing, more than one thousand players have already created an account this way. Welcome!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/362c1c4379f023aeeb3342576f6ef5f0b7a3d177.jpg[/img]

[h1]Speak to me[/h1]
Players now must choose a language upon entering Angeldust for the first time. You can also see the new user interface style here. All major elements are now decorated and animated like paper scrolls:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/32243703278d4309f176058d8e18810c2310f131.jpg[/img]

[h1]Weapon of choice[/h1]
Filtering. Yes. Quickly find the block you're looking for in both your inventory and the shop. Choose a color or block type and you're off. Use the E/F keys on a keyboard or D-pad up/down on a game controller:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/0da6d1c041b51e215d6565b4ee778293107be012.gif[/img]

The paper scroll decorations in scrollable lists are clickable for actually scrolling. Handy!

[h1]Bean counting[/h1]
The in-game announcements for discovering creatures, materials, trees and more now all feature numerical counters so you know how much stuff you can still discover (this screenshot shows the old visual style):

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/768cc4837058c00f3c2c5ed64e700a7233237f98.jpg[/img]

But we didn't stop here. There's now a full-fledged in-game progress overview, accessible from the telecharger:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/ae3b9543d1e4fad90a059005ac1e5a80ffc92bae.jpg[/img]

[h1]… we found 'mute' and we're happy[/h1]
Steam users rejoice—you can finally mute your hero. It's been a long time coming since the Steam Greenlight days, but it's finally here:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/cf7fd4f9b01da9d28dd3ad713cb7df8d1eac9e4e.jpg[/img]

There's a bunch of major features without cool screenshots. On Steam/desktop platforms (Windows / Mac / Linux) Angeldust will now default to normal instead of huge text size and enable smooth rotation for nicer visuals on high-FPS systems. You can now also somewhat use the tab-key to navigate form fields.

On all platforms Angeldust will now lay out text much better to prevent crossing user interface element boundaries. Long text is now automatically scaled down to fit. A small tweak, but very welcomed.

Speaking of text, you can now copy chat log contents to the system clipboard using a button. Pretty useful in plenty of occasions!

We've also simplified the Angeldust Terms of Use and stopped sending account activation e-mails to new players. Just enjoy the game!

notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v2.20:

[h1]License to Build[/h1]
Build with both your best and your newest friends! Give and retract building permissions for your land claims right from the telecharger. Meet friend. Permit friend. Build a lasting friendship together:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/6c6897fd91ab989a39a74494e2c4394d8384ac6f.jpg[/img]

Your friends are notified of their new permissions:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/ed15f99146e3805adb20fcc822a81f0ba57b921f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Details Are Forever[/h1]
You can now enjoy Angeldust in a new 'detailed' visual style where many textures have additional details. See this dimly lit comparison:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/db335fce26b4aeac893927a46bdd47491e3d99e2.gif[/img]

Shelves now sport books. Timber framing is made of wood. Windows have glass in them. Doors have actual hinges and knobs. I already feel at home:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/a0d30f7897f1b549ea5b83a8e20541cf407aec68.jpg[/img]

[h1]The World Is Not Enough[/h1]
You could already freely explore the beautiful Angeldust game world. But the world isn't enough. Family motto. So you can now visit beautiful world wonders at the press of a telecharger button:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/c628420c1de6a83a988cf8f73004ffcad51f0597.jpg[/img]

You can meet up with other players at wonders. At regular intervals a different wonder is loaded into the telecharger. New wonders are continuously added. Here's one. Wondrous indeed:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/ab39552e3b742ce0bcfc3b436450ac41819d6cbb.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v2.19:

notes.title: Angeldust v2.18 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v2.18:

[h1]Improved texture set![/h1]
It took awhile, but Angeldust now as an improved and polished texture set. Buildings now really stand out, mountains are more impressive and the overall presence of being 'in the game world' is much improved.

There will be a more extensive post on this improvement, but here are a few initial screenshots already, showing parts of the new texture set on builds by Geldis and KitoBär:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/2747ef757afc722eb098cc5749a9d5033e7e51b4.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/a0586164c122d75dcf169518d7291e95011b2c65.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/bbab7149a2b65458408b527408ccb9039a573033.jpg[/img]

[h1]Trees, a crowd![/h1]
The builder hero can now discover, unlock and plant trees. Target the tree trunk with your axe and swing. Your axe will even glow yellow and give off sparks in the hotbar:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/96eeaf29b73febccfd5b5358b7fe3b898fade160.jpg[/img]

Each tree gives you 750 coins. That's some easy cash up for grabs:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/02661ad5421fca1fba410b77310053a21024af98.jpg[/img]

Planting is as easy as well. Select the tree from your inventory, and use it on the spot where you want it. You'll need plenty of room (trees are big!) and you can only place them on top of blocks:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/ba42314506ae7e6ef3a527ee9a8232daaa70da02.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hint, hint![/h1]
The 'new stuff' nearby hint is now more awesome than ever before. Along with the extra sparks flying of your shovel and axe, it's hard to miss new, unlockable items in the game world:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/00ac36d98d479560f50e4da3917e584e46263b6f.gif[/img]

In addition, the Angeldust website (at PlayAngeldust.com) will now also list trees as possible discoveries in each of the game world areas:

[h1]Iconic improvements[/h1]
Speaking of the Angeldust website, it now has updated block icons with a transparent background. Also, the stairs block icons now have shadows (in-game, too!):

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/d1b19d1ac531fce08db875e5ed8d06aee7072e0a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] fix hedge block not sticking to other materials
[*] added fences around village park trees
[*] improve village foliage appearance consistency
[*] allow riding on undiscovered creatures
[*] fix water color not being affected by fog
[/list]

notes.title: Angeldust v2.17 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v2.17:

[h1]Bears. Beets…[/h1]
You can now ride bears! Many players asked for this, mostly from Russia. It's [i]beary[/i] exciting to ride one of these bad boys, so give it a try!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/22e20bf20589ab6f345daf020daf96aa7c013fbd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mr. Bones' Wild Ride[/h1]
Ridden creatures will now turn wild as soon as you start riding another creature, because they're pretty jealous. This also happens to mitigate the strategy of quickly neutralizing groups of enemies by quickly riding and dismounting them.

[h1]> moonwalking in 2017 lol[/h1]
Since the launch of Angeldust, players have been moonwalking everywhere. Very fashionable in the 80's, but somewhat out of style in 2017. So we fixed it! You'll actually walk backwards now. Hurray for the 21st century!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/fef761cecfc16111c007c0cf472a640b8a9ec829.gif[/img]

[h1]Golden. Delicious.[/h1]
On some platforms, there was a bug where the treasure material didn't properly flow into other materials, leading to openings in the game world geometry. This is fixed, so you won't see gaps like these anymore:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/5f93bda153761ca2a5636d286417726e691f417f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ludo Ergo Sum[/h1]
Another doozie: creatures (and other entities) in the Angeldust game world now remain live while nobody is looking. Thanks to this improved game world permanence, you'll no longer lose your mount when walking:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/408eaa6094aaa1c740e68cc194a6b17e39984910.gif[/img]

[h1]Call of Cutie[/h1]
Speaking of losing your mount. Don't! With Angeldust v2.17 you can call your horse by flourishing. Double tap the 'F'-key, the rightmost (B)-button on your game controller or the flourish icon on your touchscreen. Once you flourish, your mount will come running towards you!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/1ffb860c9b54241878fad3fa160148a5d5056fa1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] optimize creature A.I. and animations for backpedalling
[*] improve visual fidelity of recorded game replays
[*] fix a few misspellings
[/list]

notes.title: Angeldust v2.14 release notes
notes.content:
Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v2.14:

[h1]Fight club[/h1]
A feature that 99,9% of the community was asking for: an improved combat system to replace Angeldust's old click fiesta. Hold the left mouse button, right trigger or tap-and-hold on a touchscreen to keep attacking:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/0497468a05ac9fea390f40bcbada695c3cfbf372.jpg[/img]

The new combat system repeats in a 3-burst pattern. You can still spam attacks like before when the going gets tough. Some players have already created a new 'short burst' clicking style. Just see what tickles your fancy.

[h1]Let's talk![/h1]
Ever found yourself unable to talk to another player because you didn't speak the same language? Introducing: [b]quick messages[/b]! Pick a line and Angeldust translates it for all players near you. Be a polyglot:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/0e97adb3bd09a00c4c319bb79d8188bdcf38d2d2.jpg[/img]

Open the quick messages menu like you would flourish before. On a keyboard, you can use the shortcut numbers to quickly select a line. Double tap the quick messages key or button to flourish like before.

[h1]Near-field communication[/h1]
The Angeldust game server will now send out notifications if a player has telecharged towards you. This makes playing together more fun since you know when people join you:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/8a0a9b0b3c27d7bf4ba0ce88ef1faf05bb53b05e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Material girl[/h1]
Last – but certainly not least – is a new feature to help out new and existing players. The shovel in the hotbar will now glow and give off sparks when unlockable new materials are nearby:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/691852f5d79280962ba61bbf7d8d881a5680524a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Additional changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved 'play together' matchmaking
[*]Improved user interface
[*]Improved game controller support
[/list]

notes.title: 165K. Furnish your dreams.
notes.content:
It's been a [i]crazy[/i] start of 2017 with four major updates to Angeldust in a single month. The Angeldust update train will keep thundering on, bringing exciting new features quicker than a certain blue hedgehog in his best days.

[h1]Turning tables[/h1]
One big community request has been to add table blocks to Angeldust. Those are coming in the next update, Angeldust v2.13! A plethora of table materials will be at your disposal:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/a9e3fbf122f46f5cd8bf1b1c2ec86b1d30073381.jpg[/img]

[h1]Stacked[/h1]
Simply bringing table blocks to the – [i]erm[/i] – table wasn't quite good enough for Firefly, our lead developer. And so tables can be stacked, combined and used for building a table tennis table, storage shelves and display cases (amongst other uses):

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/ea3c0eceff6a1f8e1673ae9f4c679c632a779506.jpg[/img]

[h1]Take a seat[/h1]
What good is a [strike]phone call if you can not speak[/strike] table without chairs? That's why the next update will also bring a cool assortment of chairs (appearance subject to change):

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/f67c0fd3b6254a92566e40838b6695b9f4f71b33.jpg[/img]

There are rumors of these chairs having special, secret properties. We believe those rumors. Because we spread them.

[h1]Picture perfect[/h1]
With dozens of new blocks, we hope you have fun decorating your creations once the next update lands. We're already looking forward to seeing your screenshots roll in on the community hub!

It's an exciting time to discover and play Angeldust with all of the big changes of the past weeks. Keep the suggestions rolling in and we'll do our best to accommodate them as well as we can ːsteamhappyː !

[h1]Be social![/h1]
Feel free to join Firefly's live stream on YouTube at 17.00h UTC, or visit/follow the other social media to always be up to date:
http://youtube.com/angeldustlive
http://facebook.com/angeldustlive
http://twitter.com/angeldustlive
http://instagram.com/playangeldust

Have fun playing and see you in the next announcement!

notes.title: Angeldust v2.11 release notes
notes.content:
Another week, another update. Here's the list of changes in Angeldust v2.11:

[h1]Light My Way[/h1]
Angeldust v2.11 brings pathways with signposts and lanterns to the game world near the village so new heroes don't get lost anymore. All signs point 'inland' – into the game world:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/9c57343c981076e026b7f642c5722a563201df22.jpg[/img]

If you have claimed land near the village, you'll probably need to remove some of the new signposts. Have fun shoveling ːsteamhappyː!

[h1]Mysterious Ways[/h1]
The 'play together in a random group' feature now drops players on a pathway. Players will need to actively go against the arrows to lose their way. Let's hope this solves the issue of players only encountering birds in a forest.

[h1]Fencing Master[/h1]
Panel blocks next to column blocks will now snap together:

notes.title: Angeldust v2.9 release notes [part 2]
notes.content:
In addition to the changes listed in the Angeldust v2.9 release notes part 1, Angeldust v2.9 brings the following new features that have been enabled today with a server update.

[h1]Player (hero) level system[/h1]
Probably the number 1 requested RPG feature for Angeldust – you can now level up and grow stronger! Coins double as experience points and you automatically show off your player level to other players in-game:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/255d0774e1e79a6b39b75aa0ee96c73484d79627.jpg[/img]

The level system will be expanded on in the future.

[h1]First-time sign-in bonus[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/ab6986b50b9bf66523a24598bebcd347dec4c00f.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Implement player (hero) level system
[*]Add first-time sign-in bonus
[*]Add chat log
[*]Improved text input to allow more – and accented – characters in chat

[*]Add user interface scrolling using the 'page down' and 'page up' keys
[*]Font rendering improvements

[*]Polish the game replay user interface a bit
[/list]

notes.title: 125K. Features for Angeldust v2.9
notes.content:
Enjoy your holidays! It's been a complete madhouse working on the Angeldust v2.9 update. We passed the 125K player mark and there's no end in sight. Even though we were eating tasty Christmas dinners and singing merry songs, the next update is just around the corner. Here's what's coming.

[h1]Just my type[/h1]
Thanks to your feedback, Angeldust v2.9 brings improved text input thanks to better UTF-8 conversion support. You can now freely say 'Tschüß', '¡Hola!' and 'Ça va bien' to your friends!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/56fba3e0acd695985739fbca386090f22842fd66.jpg[/img]

[h1]Captain's log…[/h1]
[strike]Stardate 20165[/strike] Seems like almost everyone asked for this feature and it's coming in Angeldust v2.9: a chat log with scrolling. Never miss a chat message again! You can now also chat using a game controller:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/95bf3f72bae560703c7b114f447838591076139e.jpg[/img]

[h1]PM or DM me plz!!1[/h1]
Available right now: send private messages to your friends using the Angeldust website at PlayAngeldust.com. The 'friends' page now has clickable friend names and online status. Friends will receive an in-game notification if you send them a private message.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/331e5cbc96ad0021630fc7a39a73ebf1f93998c2.jpg[/img]

[h1]We have many secrets[/h1]
Angeldust v2.9 will bring a huge, secret, new feature to the game that will lay the foundation for a lot of cool stuff in the future. Leave your best guesses about this feature in the comments!

There's also rendering and performance improvements so Angeldust runs even smoother than before. Also, here's a random picture of a few cool houses built by Rabotik, Lily chan and Mechalien:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/fbb0c87d9da327b898eb80e3b7ce8e9264f16cab.jpg[/img]

[h1]Be social![/h1]
Feel free to join Firefly's live stream on YouTube at 17.00h UTC, or visit/follow the other social media to always be up to date:
http://youtube.com/angeldustlive
http://facebook.com/angeldustlive
http://twitter.com/angeldustlive
http://instagram.com/playangeldust

Have fun playing and see you in the next announcement!

notes.title: Angeldust v2.8 release notes
notes.content:
Angeldust v2.8 brings the following new features and improvements:

[h1]Share claimed land with friends[/h1]
You can now choose which of your friends can build on your claimed land. Open up the Angeldust website and set the permission to 'YES' for all friends that you trust well enough to give access to your claimed lands:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/0b0e2a991b674b77376fa297b8499f5c9fee435e.jpg[/img]

[h1]View claimed land permissions[/h1]
In-game, claimed land is displayed using three different colors now. Yellow denotes your claimed land. Green indicates friendly claimed land where you can build. Grey claimed land is unbuildable:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/13b866b6ede6490faf40fa1a85cbb2e1288d8976.jpg[/img]

[h1]Inland guide[/h1]
Angeldust v2.8 brings an inland guide that will guide you into the game world. A friendly, green arrow will point you in the right direction at all times:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/050ce5508871f778e4b4917990d5feea417cc65d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rendering fixes[/h1]
Rendering large structures comprised of many blocks is fixed. Here's a big castle built by Geldis shown in all its glory:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/8d78ce2930638c85f2fc47978c285c275b2ced27.jpg[/img]

[h1]Building and telecharger improvements[/h1]
House height and land claims have been reduced in price. You can now claim up to 48 lands. The telecharger now lists four claimed lands per row to ease navigation:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/a1047d042bbe31b8e94790ca9e0dd5cb5682cbdb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Game world is now claim-to-build[/h1]
The Angeldust game world has become claim-to-build to improve its look and feel. The user interface will now give hints on how to claim land and build there:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/46fde5657a857fea5488fdf7042cbf19b1a12fba.jpg[/img]

[h1]Additional improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]The 'C'-key and game controller bumper buttons switch third-person view
[*]Greatly polished claimed land user interface
[*]Major performance and stability improvements
[*]Fixed hit spark sound artifacts
[*]Additional user interface polishing
[*]Reduce sprinting cool down (rolled out previously)
[*]Minor text fixes
[/list]

notes.title: 100K. Angeldust v2.8 this week.
notes.content:
100,000. Or 100.000. Depends on your decimal notation. It's a gigantic number any way you look at it. Thanks for all the love everyone. Here's what's coming this week.

[h1]Share your love[/h1]
TOP REQUEST: be able to build together on claimed land. We did it! This is coming. You decide which of your friends you trust enough to give access to your claimed lands.

In-game you'll see different colored claim boxes. Yellow is yours. Green is available for building thanks to your friend. Grey is hands off:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/13b866b6ede6490faf40fa1a85cbb2e1288d8976.jpg[/img]

[h1]User interface polishing[/h1]
Lots of cool stuff here: use the 'C'-key or game controller bumper buttons to instantly toggle third-person view. Faraway claim boxes now fade out. Hit spark sounds during big battles are not choppy anymore. The Telecharger now lists four claimed lands per row. Inland guide. And much more…

[h1]Rendering and bug fixes[/h1]
Some heroes built gigantic castles. Like Geldis. This introduced minor rendering errors in the corner of some areas. That has been fixed. Some player's computers scrambled game data, leading to crashes. That's fixed too, to keep Angeldust rock-solid.

Here's Geldis' castle in its full glory for your viewing pleasure:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26892681/8d78ce2930638c85f2fc47978c285c275b2ced27.jpg[/img]

[h1]Claim your stake[/h1]
Angeldust v2.8 will lower the cost of claimable land and house heightening. You will be refunded the coins you spent earlier. You'll also be able to claim up to 48 land claims instead of 24. So make a mark on the world.

[h1]Update schedule[/h1]
We're aiming to release Angeldust v2.8 coming Thursday or Friday around 09.00h UTC. The game server and website might briefly be down for maintenance.

[h1]Happy holidays[/h1]
It might be early. It might be late. We hope your holidays will be great! Here's a cool snowman built by moebius:

notes.title: Angeldust v2.7 release notes
notes.content:
Angeldust v2.7 brings the following new features and improvements:

[h1]Claimable land[/h1]
Claim up to 24 lands in the game world for yourself so other players can not modify your buildings. Land claims are 32 x 32 blocks in size and 64 blocks tall. Chain together multiple land claims to build huge castles and structures.

Land claims proudly show your player name to other players, so show off your best building skills and admire the work of others! Each and every land claim gets a spot in your Telecharger so you can instantly teleport to them.

[h1]Random group: Play together![/h1]
Feeling lucky? Press the 'play together' button on top of your telecharger to teleport to a random starting location in the game world. Head into battle with other random players who pressed the button.

The availability of other players depends on many factors, so wait around a bit and/or use the button a few times to check if others show up.

[h1]Updated game world layout[/h1]
The composition of the game world has changed slightly which may cause some of your buildings to be raised above, or lowered into the natural landscape. For now, this will be the only change to the game world, so please patch up your buildings this once.

[h1]Interface improvements[/h1]
– Most in-game menus now have a clearer layout with more prominent section headers.
– Any upcoming game server restarts (like with this update) will now be announced in the game client.
– The compass's 'inland' direction now has priority over 'homewards'.

http://youtube.com/AngeldustLive

[h1]Protip: have fun![/h1]

notes.title: 100% Awesome. Again!
notes.content:
Thanks for your positive reviews! Thanks for the warm welcome! Angeldust is doing great after its sensational release on Steam Early Access. Join our daily live stream at 17.00h UTC to celebrate: http://youtube.com/angeldustlive !

[h1]'Hot game' means 'hot server'[/h1]
Mere minutes after release, thousands upon thousands of players came to play Angeldust. Our server got hot. Hotter. [b]The hottest[/b]. Lead Angeldust developer Firefly had to cut his live stream short to fix the melting server:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bHMKz-iMSXM
The old server couldn't keep up because of network restrictions outside of our control. Firefly tried valiantly to work around the issue, but couldn't solve it live. That's when push came to shove.

Under two hours later, a new server had been mounted in a server rack and became operational. At midnight local time, Angeldust was performing stronger, better and faster than ever. Firefly did an emergency live stream and Angeldust kept up under the madness:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UBi9GrV3nW4

[h1]'Hot game' means 'hot content'[/h1]
With thousands of new heroes joining our open world, there are thousands of buildings being crafted. Take a look at all the amazing screenshots in the community hub: houses; castles; sculptures; even airships [i]ahoy[/i]!
http://steamcommunity.com/app/488440/screenshots/

Feel free to add your own screenshots as well! This will be a great source for regular community content updates from Angeldust heroes all over the world.

A side effect of Angeldust's limitless building possibilities is that some players try to create offending works. We are doing the best we can to limit exposure to these lighthearted, artistic attempts.

[h1]'Hot game' means 'hot weekend'[/h1]
Releasing on Steam Early Access has been a great start to our weekend. Angeldust has been received very positively and is currently ranked 2 in the popular new Early Access releases. Thanks again for your positive reviews!

If you want to get in touch with the Angeldust community and team, feel free to check out our official social media presence via these links:
http://youtube.com/angeldustlive
http://facebook.com/angeldustlive
http://twitter.com/angeldustlive
http://instagram.com/playangeldust

Have fun playing and see you in the next announcement!
